headline: Lambeth accounts receive third disclaimed auditor opinion
committee: Audit and Risk Committee Lambeth, 22 October 2026
keyPointsHeading: What did the external audit find?

watchability.hook: Lambeth accounts receive third disclaimed auditor opinion
watchability.hookStyle: Immediate factual council decision and resident impact
watchability.localRelevance: Directly affects Lambeth residents and council services

claims.statement: Lambeth Council received a disclaimed opinion from external auditors Forvis Mazars on its financial statements.
claims.sourceQuote: Lambeth Council's financial statements for the year ending March 2026 have received a disclaimed opinion from external auditors Forvis Mazars.
claims.sourceDocument: Audit and Risk Committee Lambeth, 22 October 2026

claims.statement: Unrecognised liabilities regarding council housing leaseholders stand at a minimum of £10 million.
claims.sourceQuote: One objection concerns unrecognised liabilities, specifically to leaseholders on the Council's housing estate, estimated at a minimum of £10 million.
claims.sourceDocument: Audit and Risk Committee Lambeth, 22 October 2026

claims.statement: The council is seeking to rebuild its General Fund reserves to £45 million.
claims.sourceQuote: Actions being taken to address these include rebuilding General Fund reserves to £45 million, establishing a financial risk reserve, and increasing HRA unallocated reserves.
claims.sourceDocument: Audit and Risk Committee Lambeth, 22 October 2026

takeawayCard.title: Disclaimed Opinion On Accounts
takeawayCard.subtitle: Auditors were unable to obtain sufficient evidence.

keyPoints: Unrecognised estate liabilities to leaseholders are estimated at a minimum of £10 million.
Lambeth is rebuilding its General Fund reserves to a target of £45 million.
Auditors confirmed three of five value for money weaknesses remain unresolved.

onScreenGraphic.headline: Lambeth accounts receive third disclaimed auditor opinion
onScreenGraphic.body: Auditors could not verify true and fair accounts.

timeline.voiceoverText: Lambeth Council has received another disclaimed audit opinion on its financial statements.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Audit and Risk Committee Lambeth, 22 October 2026 · Story #10914

data.highlightPhrase: disclaimed opinion on whether accounts present a true and fair view

timeline.voiceoverText: External auditors Forvis Mazars reported that they were unable to obtain sufficient evidence to verify the council accounts.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Audit and Risk Committee Lambeth, 22 October 2026 Public Reports Pack

onScreenGraphic.headline: What did the external audit find?

timeline.voiceoverText: The audit highlighted unrecognised housing liabilities of ten million pounds and persistent weaknesses in budget and procurement controls.
While Lambeth targets forty-five million pounds in reserves, major financial gaps remain unresolved without extraordinary government assistance.
timeline.citationFooter: SOURCE: Audit and Risk Committee Lambeth, 22 October 2026 · Verified Record
